source.notes: Weights per stat point; Hit and Block weight per rating point. Recipe Hit is given as percent while Armory Hit is a rating. Spell Power adds both spell damage and healing as Pawn Forever documents. Generic weapon DPS maps to Ranged DPS for wands, guns and other ranged-slot weapons, Melee DPS for melee weapons. The protected primary attribute is an app preference, separate from GearQuest weights. No conditional Attack Power Vs Beasts weight.
